name: @sax/design-tokens
description: SAX Capital design tokens. DTCG 2025.10 JSON is the source of truth; Style Dictionary v5 transforms it per product into deployable CSS.

scripts.validate: ajv validate --spec=draft7 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/format.json -d 'tokens/**/*.tokens.json' && ajv validate --spec=draft7 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/resolver.json -d 'resolvers/*.resolver.json'
scripts.build: npm run generate:resolvers && npm run validate && npm run check:color && npm run build:tokens && npm run build:preview && npm run build:home && npm run build:blog && npm run build:presentation && npm run build:docs
